title: Chapter 631 - 631 Visiting; I Made A Reservation!

Chapter 631 - 631 Visiting; I Made A Reservation!

Chapter 631 - 631 Visiting; I Made a Reservation!

631 Visiting; I Made a Reservation!

At this moment…

Lin Fan felt as though all the pedestrians in the distance, the tall buildings in front of him, and the road beneath his feet… disappeared.

In his eyes, there was only a beautiful figure—Xia Xue.

Time… It was as if it had been frozen.

Everyone was in a state of stillness.

Xia Xue was stared at by Lin Fan. Her pretty face blushed as she said, “Why are you looking at me like that?”

Only then did Lin Fan react. “This outfit suits you very well. You look very beautiful.”

“Is that so?” Xia Xue became more and more shy.

Then, she tried her best to change the topic and said, “By the way, have you had dinner?”

Lin Fan shook his head. “Not yet.”

Xia Xue said, “Then you’re lucky today!”

“Do you see that? It’s the nine-star Imperial Hotel! Other than being a student at Jiangbei University, I’m also a live streamer for Sea Shark!

“Today, I’m going to the nine-star Imperial Hotel for a live broadcast! As long as you get your android to help me hold the camera, you can eat the delicacies of the Imperial Hotel for free later.

“How is it? Isn’t it very cost-effective?”

As Xia Xue spoke, there was a touch of expectation on her pretty face.

Lin Fan was stunned.

Xia Xue was a famous streamer in this world?

After a while, Lin Fan nodded. “Of course.”

“Alright, get ready for the live broadcast!” Xia Xue said happily.

As soon as she finished speaking, she took out a foldable monitor from her pocket.

Very soon, an extremely clear image appeared on the screen.

The live broadcast… began!

Xia Xue’s voice was very sweet. She had a charming appearance and was very good at choosing the theme…

After a few times, she gained quite a bit of popularity on Sea Shark.

Not long after she started streaming, someone started leaving comments.

Zhu Xuan: [Ah! Our Lil Xue is starting her live broadcast!]

Qingchun Won’t Come: [Imperial Hotel! Xia Xue is really trustworthy. She really came to the Imperial Hotel!]

Student Xiaoming: [I’ve long heard of the Imperial Hotel’s name. Today, I can finally take a good look.]

Newcomer: [Looking forward to Xia Xue’s live broadcast.]

Wind: [Huh? Why is there someone standing next to Xia Xue? From his back, he looks quite tall and a little handsome.]

Flower: [Handsome? According to my many years of experience, this is definitely a handsome man! He’s super handsome!]

…

In the screen of the live broadcast room, Xia Xue was seen walking forward with a brisk pace.

It had to be said that the Imperial Hotel was indeed extraordinary.

The hall was ten meters high, with diamond chandeliers, gold-inlaid floors, and white jade carvings… The luxury of the hotel was revealed everywhere.

Although Xia Xue was already mentally prepared, after seeing this scene, she could not help but be stunned.

At this moment, a waiter in a suit walked over with a smile and said respectfully, “Welcome to the Imperial Hotel. How can I help you?”

When Xia Xue heard it, she came back to her senses and said, “Uhh… Hello, I want to eat here.”

“Do you have a reservation?” asked the waiter.

“No, I don’t,” Xia Xue said.

“I’m very sorry,” the waiter said apologetically. “All the tables in our Imperial Hotel have been reserved for the next 15 days. If you want to eat here, you can reserve a table for after 15 days.”

Xia Xue was somewhat incredulous. “Have all the tables been reserved?”

One had to know…

The Imperial Hotel was 365 stories high.

Even though many of them were rooms and banquet halls…

The dining area would definitely take up a lot of space.

In the end, the place was fully booked for 15 days?

“Yes.” The waiter apologized again.

Xia Xue was a little disappointed.

She had already promised her fans that she would visit the Imperial Hotel.

In addition, she had heard of the Imperial Hotel a long time ago. Her dream was to come in and taste the delicacies.

Her promises and expectations were about to turn into bubbles.

Lin Fan also saw the disappointment in Xia Xue’s heart and said, “Don’t worry, I’ve already booked a table.”

Xia Xue could not help blinking her eyes, her pretty face full of doubts.

“I’m Lin Fan,” Lin Fan said to the waiter.

“Mr. Lin, please wait a moment.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he quickly took out the folding screen and searched.

But soon, the waiter hesitated and said, “Mr. Lin, I’m sorry. I don’t seem to have found any information about your reservation in the system. Of course, there might be some loopholes in the system.

“Excuse me, do you have your reservation information? If it’s convenient, can I take a look?”

It had to be said that the Imperial Hotel was indeed a nine-star hotel.

Just the service of the waiters was far from what ordinary restaurants could compare to.

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “I don’t have any reservation information. You can call your general manager, Wang You. He knows.”

No reservation information?

Moreover, he had to ask the general manager himself?

The waiter could not help but hesitate.

After all, he could not just call the general manager for no reason.

If the general manager was not satisfied, the consequences would be very serious.

However, the waiter could feel the extraordinary aura coming from Lin Fan. He gritted his teeth and said, “Mr. Lin, please wait a moment.”

After saying that, he walked to the side and took out his phone. After hesitating for a moment, he made a call.

If he called, he might just make the general manager unhappy.

However, if he neglected a possible VIP, it would definitely make the general manager furious.

…

Xia Xue quietly pulled the corner of Lin Fan’s clothes and said, “He’s going to call the general manager now. What should we do later?”

Obviously, Xia Xue did not think that Lin Fan had already booked a table. How could he have booked a table with the general manager.

Xia Xue felt that Lin Fan was just deliberately bluffing the waiter and taking the opportunity to get a table.

It was no wonder Xia Xue would think so.

The Imperial Hotel was one of the top five nine-star hotels in Xia Alliance!

The general manager of the Imperial Hotel was definitely a very important person.

Lin Fan was just a freshman at Jiangbei University. How could he possibly get a table from the general manager?

Lin Fan naturally understood Xia Xue’s thoughts and smiled. “Don’t worry, it’s not a problem.”

At this moment, the waiter had already put down his phone and walked over quickly.

“Hello, Mr. Lin. This way, please.” The waiter bowed and spoke in a much more respectful tone than before.

The words of the general manager, Wang You, seemed to still echo in his ears.

“Mr. Lin is the most distinguished guest of our Imperial Hotel! I’m on my way there now. Before that, you have to ensure that Mr. Lin receives excellent service!

“After this, I will give you the highest reward!”

The waiter had never heard the general manager speak in such a serious tone.

He understood that Mr. Lin was definitely an extraordinary existence.

The waiter was secretly glad that he had called the general manager.
